O. I. D.
F. O. REG
No 299
Date 20/6/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

17th June 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that some of the rebel leaders in
Frenchtown are trying to disband their followers, but
are experiencing considerable difficulty in doing so
through lack of funds.
Yesterday the rebel chief Han Hwei 韓恢 informed
his men who are about 40 strong that he did not require
their services further, whereupon they demanded $200
each, threatening that they would loot if the money
was not forthcoming.
It is reported that Sun Yat Sen has received a
telegram from Peking saying that Li Yuen Hung is not
in a position to exercise the power of appertaining
to his office, and is ruler of China in name only,
all the power being in the hands of Tuan Chi Jui.
The Szechuen merchants in Shanghai have received
telegrams from their native province advising them
to ship no goods to Szechuen as there is considerable
unrest in that province at present.
It is rumoured that the Military Authorities are
quarrelling regarding the attitude to be assumed
towards the new President.
General Yang despatched two hundred soldiers to
Zau Woo Ching 漕涇 village, on the 16th instant.

Your obedient servant,

mmmuamustra

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Received am June 17.

O. I. D.
F. O. REG
第 299 号
日期 16/6/20

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年6月17日。

先生：

据报，法租界的一些叛乱首领正试图遣散其追随者，但因缺乏资金，在此过程中遇到相当大的困难。

昨日，叛乱首领韩恢（Han Hwei）告知其手下约40人，称不再需要他们的服务，随后这些人每人索要200美元，并威胁若拿不到钱将进行抢劫。

据报，孙中山收到来自北京的一封电报，称黎元洪（Li Yuen Hung）无法行使与其职位相称的权力，仅是名义上的中国统治者，所有实权均掌握在段祺瑞（Tuan Chi Jui）手中。

在沪的四川商人收到来自家乡的电报，建议他们不要向四川发货，因为该省目前局势相当动荡。

有谣言称，军方当局就应对新任总统采取何种态度而发生争执。

杨将军于本月16日派遣两百名士兵前往漕泾（Zau Woo Ching）村。

您顺从的仆人，

mmmuamustra

首席侦探督察。

警务处总监。

6月17日上午收悉。
